descriptions.zh-Hans: 信使自绘的刨冰杯，水果色沿杯子慢慢展开。
descriptions.en: The messenger’s hand-drawn shaved ice cup has fruit-colored streaks along its sides.

descriptions.zh-Hans: 信使饭后画的炸大蕉，一小一大两片在纸上换了位置。
descriptions.en: In the messenger’s after-lunch sketch, a small and a large piece of fried plantain have exchanged places.

descriptions.zh-Hans: 信使做的纸终点可以展开，给慢慢走的人多留一点路。
descriptions.en: The messenger’s paper finish unfolds to leave slow walkers a little more path.

descriptions.zh-Hans: 信使自己拼的色纸，一块故意没有找同色伙伴。
descriptions.en: The messenger’s own paper collage leaves one color without a matching partner.

descriptions.zh-Hans: 信使折的纸鞋抬起一点，又轻轻放回纸路上。
descriptions.en: The messenger’s folded paper shoe lifts slightly before settling on its paper path.

descriptions.zh-Hans: 信使自制的纸拉卡，拉开后小脚印才一同向前。
descriptions.en: The messenger’s original pull card sends its little footprints forward together.
